content_en: Case study worth every entrepreneur to see James Fleischmann. Same doing technology why some work themselves to death earn no money some can achieve three thousand dollars annual income. Gap is not in technology but in a model you never thought about. After finishing this story today you will reunderstand the word making money. On subway during morning rush. Scrolling phone saw post doing independent development for almost two years monthly income still hovering should I give up. I resisted not replying. But I thought of James Fleischmann. This is James Fleischmann story. No financing no luck no overnight success. Just thoroughly thought about one thing then repeatedly do it. You can continue to next case or turn off screen think. Is my current pattern selling time or building system. Original author James Fleischmann original source https://www.indiehackers.com/post/fgJbWfKrigaJkqkTdVmg. This article based on Indie Hackers case library.
content_jp: James Fleischmann值得每一个创业者看的案例.同样搞技术为什么有人累死累活赚不到钱有人能做到年收入3千美元.差距不在技术在于一个你从来没想过的模型.今天讲完这个故事你会重新理解赚钱这两个字.早高峰地铁上.刷手机看到一个帖子做独立开发快两年了月收入还在徘徊该放弃吗我忍住了没回.但我想到了James Fleischmann.这就是James Fleischmann的故事.没有融资没有运气爆棚没有一夜爆红.就是把一件事想透了然后反复做.你可以继续看下一个案例也可以关掉屏幕想一想我现在的模式是在卖时间还是在建系统.原文作者James Fleischmann原文来源https://www.indiehackers.com/post/fgJbWfKrigaJkqkTdVmg本文基于Indie Hackers案例库改写.
content_ar: دراسة حالة تستحق كل رائد أعمال لمشاهدة James Fleischmann. نفس doing technology لماذا البعض يعمل نفسه حتى الموت يكسب money والبعض يستطيع تحقيق 3k دولار دخل سنوي. الفجوة ليست في التكنولوجيا بل في نموذج لم تفكر فيه ابداً. بعد finish هذه القصة اليوم ستعيد فهم كلمة كسب المال. في المترو خلال ساعة الذروة. تصفح الهاتف رأى منشور doing independent development for almost 2 years monthly income still hovering should I give up. resistت لكن لم أجب. لكنني فكرت في James Fleischmann. هذه هي قصة James Fleischmann. بدون تمويل بدون luck بدون نجاح ليلة وضحاها. فقط thinking thoroughly about one thing ثم repeatedly do it. You can continue to next case or turn off screen think.
